description: Source code for the OpenAPIConverter class in the mockserver project, responsible for converting OpenAPI specifications into mock expectations and responses.

classes.name: OpenAPIConverter
classes.description: A class that converts OpenAPI specifications into mock server expectations and responses.

methods.name: buildExpectations
methods.description: Builds a list of expectations from an OpenAPI spec URL or payload and a map of operations to responses.

methods.name: buildHttpResponse
methods.description: Constructs an HttpResponse object based on OpenAPI response definitions.

methods.name: isJsonContentType
methods.description: Checks if a content type string represents JSON content.

methods.name: findExample
methods.description: Finds an example object from a Header or MediaType.

methods.name: serialise
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON string, with error handling and logging.
